subject: How to use udpateSelectInput() in a dynamic UI?

messages.author: 7cc4d3270d5c8d14
messages.subject: How to use udpateSelectInput() in a dynamic UI?
parts:
Friends,

I am trying to create a dynamic UI for filtering a data frame where users can specify multiple conditions. I was able to create controls on the fly but struggling to update the ui elements to selected values. While I am able to store the input values in a data frame for later use, I am not able to update the elements as they automatically revert back to default. I am sure I am doing something silly here but could not figure out after spending hours. My code may not be tidy but am learning a lot from this forum. Any hit would be great.

Here is the gist:

https://gist.github.com/drramki/8251165

runGist("8251165")

Thanks.
